guards: every skill documenting a command into scripts/.claude-skills/ warns that the tree is absent in a linked git worktree

poisonPill.why: A SKILL.md that still documents `node scripts/…` — so it stays in the subject set — with the worktree-preflight block removed and nothing else changed. This is the silent variant: the file parses, every other skill check passes, and the only symptom is an agent in a linked worktree hitting a bare MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a command the skill told it to run. The fixture deliberately KEEPS the tooling command, because removing it would drop the skill out of scope and let the gate pass — a pill that proves nothing while appearing to work.
